obligations.oracle: real host PlatformPointerBatch and production Windows dispatch tests
obligations.acceptance: handle drag changes real preview/committed object; secondary pointer cannot steal; debug capture and cancellation clear transient state

obligations.requirement: Only release commits once; cancel/rejected/no-op drag commits none.
obligations.oracle: semantic records/generation/operation ledger assertions against real host
obligations.acceptance: move=0; changed release=1; cancel/rejected=0; failed publication does not reject accepted semantic commit

obligations.requirement: Object pixels and selection chrome follow the same transform, including zoom/pan and repeated transformations.
obligations.oracle: Skia RGBA readbacks, independent literal geometry expectations and existing overlay matrix tests
obligations.acceptance: preview differs; cancel restores exact bytes; release matches preview; nonidentity viewport honors local->world->view

obligations.requirement: Successful transform participates in existing EditorHistory.
obligations.oracle: real transform undo/redo records and raster comparisons
obligations.acceptance: undo restores exact original transform; redo restores exact committed transform; history blocked while active

obligations.oracle: focused existing G4/G45/G46/DebugUI tests and diff check
obligations.acceptance: all focused tests pass; no forbidden files or SDK locks mutated
